journal.title: Chapter 1 — A Place to Begin
journal.text: The shelter is damaged, the beacon is dark, and the old bridge has collapsed. Three islands drift within sight.

journal.title: First Steps
journal.text: Build the first shelter. Reward: 50 XP · 25 coins · basic housing.

journal.title: Hold Fast
journal.text: Unlock bridge construction in the workshop. Reward: 30 XP · bridges unlocked.

journal.title: Reached level 2: Settler
journal.text: Unlocked Food Garden, Water Collector, Storage House.

journal.title: Heavy Rain
journal.text: Collectors overflow. Rope bridges creak.

journal.title: A Place for Water
journal.text: Maintain three actions of water reserves for 3 consecutive actions. Reward: 60 XP · Water Collector blueprint.

journal.title: Reached Verdant Reach
journal.text: A living forest and farming island. Bring back timber, food, seeds and building materials; preserve its grove as your settlement grows.

journal.title: The First Bridge
journal.text: Connect New Haven to any resource island. Reward: 100 XP · 30 coins · island production.

journal.title: Reached level 3: Builder
journal.text: Unlocked Solar Farm, Reinforced Stone bridges, Market.

journal.title: A Garden in the Sky
journal.text: Achieve a food surplus after an action. Reward: 75 XP · Starter Garden upgrade (+2 food).

journal.title: Keep the Lights On
journal.text: Keep energy positive for 5 consecutive actions. Reward: 100 XP · Crystal Battery blueprint.

journal.title: Reached level 4: Steward
journal.text: Unlocked Clinic, Community Hall.

journal.title: Crosswind
journal.text: Bridges sway. Turbines sing.

journal.title: Reached Rain Island
journal.text: Waterfalls, rain collectors and quiet fishing pools supply fresh water, irrigation and aquatic materials. Upgrade collection to support a larger town.

journal.title: Reached Prism Shelf
journal.text: Blue energy crystals rise through ancient stone shelves. Mine crystals and recover power-generation materials for solar farms, batteries and advanced buildings.

journal.title: The Clean Route
journal.text: Connect Verdant Reach, Rain Island and Prism Shelf to New Haven. Reward: 250 XP · clean transit badge.

journal.title: Reached level 5: Sky Engineer
journal.text: Unlocked Wind Turbine, Crystal Battery.

journal.title: Solar Storm
journal.text: Panels flicker; solar output is halved.

journal.title: Reached Mercy Rise
journal.text: The white-stone hospital and its airship landing return to the skyways. Connect the island for care, happier residents and room for community buildings.

journal.title: Reached Hearthside
journal.text: Lantern-lit cottages, gardens and quiet lanes offer homes for eight more residents. Bridge the village to New Haven when the town is ready to grow.
